title: Endless Museum Placement Rules v1
units: metres on a 1 m planning grid

rules.goal: Measured geometry must fit inside the artifact's minimum valid envelope.
The floorplan must supply the hard zone or explicitly allow enough expansion.
The offered plinth, wall, table, stage, or floor must match the artifact contract.
The placement mode must be one the artifact can physically use.
Rotation must preserve the artifact's authored interaction orientation.
Against-wall placement requires the contracted wall side to exist.
Zero rear clearance is valid only when the contract declines circulation behind the artifact.
Lineage may influence order, but no neighboring artifact may silently enter reserved space.
Use the preferred envelope when the floorplan can grow or release surplus space.
Artifacts declaring full-orbit circulation keep a continuous route around the hard zone.
